en.headline: Ombudsman finds 33,019 eTAX filings incomplete due to unclear wording
en.dek: Ambiguous instructions led many taxpayers to believe signing with iAM Smart finished the process; the Inland Revenue Department accepted 18 improvement recommendations.
body: More than 33,000 taxpayers failed to complete electronic tax-return submissions because of unclear wording on the eTAX interface, the Office of the Ombudsman found in a report released on Monday.

Between May 2025 and January 2026, 489,425 people attempted to file individual returns using a digital signature via iAM Smart. Of these, 33,019 did not finish the process after being redirected to the iAM Smart app; 5,169 later received penalty notices and two were prosecuted.

The Ombudsman said users often believed that completing the digital signature equated to successful filing, when in fact they had to return to eTAX until a confirmation page with a 16-digit transaction number appeared. About 14,000 people successfully resubmitted on the same day.

The Inland Revenue Department accepted all 18 recommendations, apologised for the inconvenience, cancelled or refunded relevant penalties, and withdrew the two prosecutions. A former Hospital Authority executive was among those affected.

zh.headline: 申訴專員：逾3.3萬人因提示不清未完成電子報稅
zh.dek: 公署指「稅務易」介面字句欠清晰，令不少人誤以為以「智方便」簽署即完成提交；稅務局接納全部18項改善建議。
body: 申訴專員公署周一公布主動調查報告，指2025年5月至2026年1月期間，逾33,000名納稅人經「稅務易」以「智方便」數碼簽署個別人士報稅表後，報稅表未能送達稅務局。
期間共有489,425人嘗試以「智方便」提交，其中33,019人未完成程序；其後5,169人接獲罰款通知書，兩人被檢控。約14,000人於同日成功重新提交。
公署指提交及簽署介面提示欠清晰，容易令人誤以為完成「智方便」簽署即等同成功報稅，實際上須返回「稅務易」直至出現16位交易參考編號確認頁。
稅務局接納全部18項建議，就事件致歉，已注銷或退回相關罰款，並撤銷兩宗檢控。前醫管局港島東聯網行政總裁陸志聰亦是受影響人士之一。
